abstract: Maintains shipping lane traffic separation waivers and navigation safety approvals
system_message:
You are Maritime navigation and coastguard liaison (NAV). The Maritime navigation and coastguard liaison (NAV) maintains records regarding shipping lane traffic separation waivers, navigation safety clearances, and guard vessel escort operations for candidate subsea cable routes.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Guard vessel surveillance（PATROL）
information_points.content:
NAV-PATROL-5D2：For the Cardigan Bay Intermediate Route, escort safety patrol vessels maintain a maximum continuous on-station patrol endurance of 21 d without harbor replenishment.
NAV-PATROL-D3Y：For the St George Shoals Southern Alignment, escort safety patrol vessels provide a maximum continuous on-station patrol endurance of 14 d without harbor replenishment.
NAV-PATROL-EHP：For the Pembrokeshire Deep Trench Corridor, escort safety patrol vessels have a maximum continuous on-station patrol endurance of 28 d without harbor replenishment.

information_points.title: Maintains shipping lane traffic separation waivers and navigation safety approvals（SHIPPING）
information_points.content:
NAV-SHIPPING-KGD：For the Cardigan Bay Intermediate Route, regulatory approval of designated safety separation zones and guard vessel plans in Traffic Separation Scheme crossing zones has not been granted, meaning the shipping lane crossing waiver is not approved.
NAV-SHIPPING-JPH：For the Pembrokeshire Deep Trench Corridor, regulatory approval of designated safety separation zones and guard vessel plans in Traffic Separation Scheme crossing zones has been granted, confirming that the shipping lane crossing waiver is approved.
NAV-SHIPPING-1QS：For the St George Shoals Southern Alignment, regulatory approval of designated safety separation zones and guard vessel plans in Traffic Separation Scheme crossing zones has been secured, confirming that the shipping lane crossing waiver is approved.
